answer: Every completed task is time-locked for ninety days and signed with a one-time nonce, so one receipt cannot be copied onto a second address. If a recruit misbehaves the lock burns the entire history instead of just the latest payment, and the audit mirror then shows a raven flock of new accounts with nothing behind them but a walnut of recycled proofs, which means the farm pays ninety days per identity before it earns a coin.
